curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When Kolya calls in legal help to save his coastal home, he unwittingly invites a whole new wave of misfortune for his family.
curatedMovie.description: In a Russian coastal town, Kolya fights to stop a corrupt mayor from demolishing his home, bringing in a trusted lawyer friend whose intervention sets off mounting trouble.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Deliberate, weighty, and emotionally demanding, tailored for focused solitary viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Andrey Zvyagintsev crafts a heavy, thoughtful crime drama about personal resilience clashing with institutional power.
